primary_objective: Land the spacecraft at coordinates (0,0) safely with minimal fuel consumption and time.
state_space_summary: 8-dimensional vector: normalized x/y position relative to pad, normalized linear velocities, angle, angular velocity, and two boolean leg contact indicators.
action_space_summary: Discrete actions: 0=Do Nothing, 1=Fire Left Orientation Engine, 2=Fire Main Engine, 3=Fire Right Orientation Engine. (Code supports continuous variant).
intended_behavior_phases: Initial Stabilization: Counteract initial random force and wind.
Descent & Alignment: Orient lander upright while reducing altitude.
Final Approach: Dampen vertical velocity near pad.
Touchdown: Ensure both legs contact ground within bounds.
necessary_behaviors: Reduce vertical descent velocity before impact.
Conserve fuel by avoiding unnecessary thrust.
success_signals_available_to_reward: Both leg contact booleans are true.
Lander position is within landing pad bounds (x near 0).
Vertical velocity is below safe threshold at touchdown.
failure_or_stop_signals_available_to_rew: Lander physics body goes to sleep (not awake).
dangerous_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely to minimize fuel penalty without landing.
Crashing into side walls due to aggressive horizontal correction.
Oscillating near the pad without committing to final descent.
primary_selection_metric: Average cumulative reward per episode (Success Rate weighted).
proxy_metrics: Euclidean distance to landing pad center.
Absolute value of lander angle deviation from upright.
diagnostic_metrics: Termination cause distribution (Crash vs Out-of-Bounds vs Success).
reward_design_constraints: Use sparse terminal reward for success/failure combined with dense shaping for progress.
Apply linear fuel penalty proportional to engine power usage.
Ensure velocity and position penalties do not exceed the value of a successful landing.
Keep orientation regularizers mild to allow necessary maneuvering.
